commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service <<'ANTRIEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-api
Group=inventory-api
WorkingDirectory=/opt/inventory-api
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT
